extracted.intended_audience: UK-based researchers and research organisations seeking ESRC/UKRI funding
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting research grant applications to ESRC/UKRI funding opportunities, ensuring eligibility, scope alignment, correct budgeting (FEC), and timely submission according to each opportunity's published metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation-only application requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to the 'UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment' opportunity — only applicants who receive an invitation may submit an application. Uninvited submissions will be ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional eligibility — UK research organisation
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to opportunities such as 'Video games and gambling-related harms'. Applicants must belong to an institution that meets UKRI eligibility criteria; individual applicants outside eligible organisations are not eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project scope and aim alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications must address the specific aims described by the opportunity (e.g., develop, validate and critique novel scientometric indicators for research assessment; improve understanding of the relationship between gambling and video games and produce policy-relevant insights).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should be directly targeted to the stated research questions and objectives of each call. Applications that do not align with the opportunity's stated aims are unlikely to be funded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fund and maximum award limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities specify the total fund available and any per-award maximum (e.g., 'We expect to fund up to £3 million'; 'Total fund: £5,000,000; Maximum award: £1,000,000').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should request budgets that fall within the maximum award where specified and be aware of the overall programme funding envelope when designing project scale and consortia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full Economic Cost (FEC) percentage funded
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding contributions may be defined as a percentage of Full Economic Cost (e.g., 'at 80% full economic cost (FEC)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing budgets, applicants must calculate Full Economic Cost and note the funded proportion (here 80%), ensuring the host organisation can cover the unfunded remainder or other co-funding arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application timing — publication/opening/closing dates and times
rubrics_metrics.description: Each opportunity lists publication, opening and closing dates and times (e.g., 'Publication date: 28 April 2026; Opening date: 28 April 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing date: 2 June 2026 4:00pm UK time').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be submitted by the stated closing date/time to be considered. Note timezone (UK time) and any specific opening windows; late submissions are typically ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity status and funding type
rubrics_metrics.description: Each listing indicates an opportunity status and funding type (e.g., 'Opportunity status: Open'; 'Funding type: Grant').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status informs whether applications are currently being accepted; funding type signals the mechanism (grant) and associated administrative rules and award management processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funders and co-funders / multi-council involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities list the funders and any co-funders or partner councils (e.g., ESRC with NERC, BBSRC, AHRC, STFC, EPSRC, MRC; Department for Science, Innovation and Technology as co-funder).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multi-funder calls may have interdisciplinary priorities, cross-council selection criteria, or additional expectations from co-funders. Applicants should review funder-specific guidance and any joint requirements.
